surprises.head: NY Rangers shut down Tampa Bay’s power play
surprises.body: Tampa Bay’s power play created 2.6 expected goals per 60, against its usual 7.5 and a league average of 7.5. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 15 games.

surprises.head: Tampa Bay leaned on its bottom six
surprises.body: Tampa Bay’s bottom-six forwards played 44% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against its usual 41% and a league average of 42%. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 10 games.
